title: CorrelateFile
description:
`correlate.kdl`: per item kind, how items of two sources match and which source wins
(spec 32.1).

CorrelateKind.description:
`kind "tool" { match "ref" "position"; prefer "native"; history "transcript"; }`. `kind "*"`
covers the kinds not named.

match.description: The keys tried in order: `ref` (the harness id), `position` (turn and order), `text`.

prefer.description: The source that wins while the binding runs.

history.description: The source that wins when history is read again.

compare.description: Fields compared in shadow mode; all of `set` when empty.
